title: 为什么越努力越焦虑？因为你正站在历史的“折叠点”上
titleEn: Why More Effort Brings More Anxiety: You Are Standing at History's Folding Point
excerpt: 读瑞·达利欧万字长文的顿悟——我们正处于大周期的第六阶段，历史的剧本，早就写好了。
excerptEn: Insights from Ray Dalio's long-form essay: we are in the sixth stage of the big cycle, and history's script was written long ago.

title: 读懂《天道》才明白：这世界从不看眼泪，真正的强者都戒掉了情绪
titleEn: Reading 'The Way of Heaven': This World Never Looks at Tears
excerpt: 这世界有两套运行逻辑：一套叫"天道"，一套叫"人道"。强者之所以强，是因为他们只认规律，不认眼泪。
excerptEn: There are two operating logics: the 'Way of Heaven' and the 'Way of Humans'. The strong are strong because they follow laws, not tears.

title: 别再等贵人了，贵人从不扶贫
titleEn: Stop Waiting for a Benefactor — They Never Hand Out Alms
excerpt: 贵人相助的本质是价值交换。如果你还是"等、靠、要"的弱者思维，贵人见了你只会绕道走。
excerptEn: Help from a benefactor is essentially value exchange. With a dependent mindset, benefactors will simply walk around you.

title: 为什么75%的人都会随大流？3个心理学真相让你清醒
titleEn: Why Do 75% of People Follow the Crowd? 3 Psychological Truths
excerpt: 阿希从众实验、米尔格拉姆服从实验、《乌合之众》——三个经典心理学研究揭示群体如何削弱理性。
excerptEn: Asch conformity, Milgram obedience, and 'The Crowd' — three classic studies revealing how groups weaken reason.
